feat(smoke): add standalone smoke workflows using native gh-aw-detection flag (#567)

Recompile the base smoke workflows with gh-aw v0.82.14 and add
smoke-{copilot,claude,codex}-standalone.md. The standalone workflows enable
the native external detector path (`features: gh-aw-detection: true`), which
downloads the published threat-detect binary from github/gh-aw-threat-detection
releases and runs it under AWF. This replaces the brittle
create-threat-detection-sibling-workflows.py container hack with a
first-class gh-aw frontmatter flag.

md_changes.file_patch:
@@ -0,0 +1,70 @@
+---
+description: Smoke test workflow that validates Copilot engine execution with the released threat-detect binary
+on:
+  workflow_dispatch:
+  schedule: daily
+permissions:
+  contents: read
+  issues: read
+  pull-requests: read
+  actions: read
+  copilot-requests: write
+name: Smoke Copilot Standalone
+engine:
+  id: copilot
+strict: false
+features:
+  gh-aw-detection: true
+network:
+  allowed:
+    - defaults
+    - github
+tools:
+  bash:
+    - "*"
+  github:
+  web-fetch:
+runtimes:
+  go:
+    version: "1.26"
+checkout:
+  fetch-depth: 1
+safe-outputs:
+  allowed-domains: [default-safe-outputs]
+  threat-detection:
+    continue-on-error: false
+  create-issue:
+    expires: 2h
+    close-older-issues: true
+    close-older-key: "smoke-copilot-standalone"
+    labels: [automation, testing]
+timeout-minutes: 15
+---
+
+# Smoke Test: Copilot Engine Validation (Standalone Detector)
+
+Keep outputs concise.
+
+This workflow validates the Copilot engine while exercising the **native external
+threat-detect path** (`features: gh-aw-detection: true`). gh-aw downloads the
+published `threat-detect` binary from the `github/gh-aw-threat-detection` releases
+and runs it under AWF, replacing the script-generated container sibling.
+
+## Test Requirements
+
+1. Use GitHub tools to read the latest 2 pull requests in `${{ github.repository }}` and record their numbers and titles only.
+2. Use `web-fetch` to fetch `https://github.com/github/gh-aw-threat-detection` and verify the response mentions `gh-aw-threat-detection`.
+3. Use bash to run `make build` in `${{ github.workspace }}` and verify it succeeds.
+4. Use bash to create a minimal artifacts directory under `/tmp/gh-aw/smoke-copilot-standalone-${{ github.run_id }}` with:
+   - `aw-prompts/prompt.txt`
+   - `agent_output.json`
+5. Use bash to run `./bin/threat-detect --version` and verify it prints a version.
+6. Use bash to write a concise status file at `/tmp/gh-aw/agent/smoke-copilot-standalone-${{ github.run_id }}.txt`.
+
+## Output
+
+Always create an issue titled `Smoke Test: Copilot Standalone - ${{ github.run_id }}` with:
+- ✅ or ❌ for each test
+- Overall status: PASS or FAIL
+- Run URL: `${{ github.server_url }}/${{ github.repository }}/actions/runs/${{ github.run_id }}`
+- Timestamp

commits.message:
fix(smoke): use gh-proxy mode for GitHub tools in standalone smokes (#608)

* fix(smoke): use gh-proxy mode for GitHub tools in standalone smokes

The standalone smoke agent jobs failed Test Requirement 1 ("read the
latest 2 pull requests") because the local Docker GitHub MCP server tool
surface was not reaching the agent ("No such tool available") and the
bash `gh` fallback was unauthenticated (issues #602, #579; same pattern
as non-standalone #581).

Switch tools.github to `mode: gh-proxy`, which uses the pre-authenticated
`gh` CLI via the AWF cli-proxy sidecar instead of the local MCP server.
The proxy authenticates from GH_AW_GITHUB_MCP_SERVER_TOKEN ||
GH_AW_GITHUB_TOKEN || GITHUB_TOKEN, so it works with the default
GITHUB_TOKEN (which already has pull-requests: read), removing both the
MCP-server startup dependency and the unauthenticated-gh failure.

This is independent of the threat-detect binary version pin (v0.2.2 vs
v0.3.0), which only affects the separate detection job.

Recompiled the three *-standalone.lock.yml files.

Co-authored-by: Copilot <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>

Co-authored-by: David Slater <12449447+davidslater@users.noreply.github.com>

* fix(smoke): recompile standalone smokes without strict override

The previous recompile inadvertently baked strict:true into the lock
files, contradicting the source frontmatter's strict:false. Recompile
honoring the declared strict:false so the generated artifacts match the
documented source configuration (addresses PR review feedback).

Co-authored-by: Copilot <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>

Co-authored-by: David Slater <12449447+davidslater@users.noreply.github.com>

commits.message:
fix(smoke): pin copilot detection model to claude-sonnet-5 (#725)

* fix(smoke): pin copilot detection model to claude-sonnet-5

The Copilot standalone smoke detection job failed under AWF with
"400 The requested model is not supported". The copilot harness (gh-aw
1.0.75) validates the requested model against the api-proxy's awf-reflect
registry, which is built from apiProxy.models in the AWF config used to
launch the sandbox. The detection job's AWF config omits apiProxy.models,
so awf-reflect has no 'auto' alias and the harness rejects
COPILOT_MODEL=auto.

Pin a concrete detection model (claude-sonnet-5) via
safe-outputs.threat-detection.model so detection no longer depends on the
'auto' alias being resolvable. Updated both the .md frontmatter and the
patched .lock.yml detection COPILOT_MODEL fallback for the latest and
stable copilot standalone smokes. Agent-job model resolution is
unaffected.

Co-authored-by: Copilot <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>

Co-authored-by: David Slater <12449447+davidslater@users.noreply.github.com>

* fix(smoke): pin copilot detection model via engine.model and recompile at gh-aw v0.84.3

The prior attempt set `threat-detection.model` (unparsed) and hand-edited the
locks, which the compiler in v0.84.0 could not honor: the detection job's
COPILOT_MODEL stayed a `vars.* || 'auto'` fallback. gh-aw v0.84.3 added the
external-detector model wiring (threatDetectionData.Model), so compiling with
`threat-detection.engine.model: claude-sonnet-5` now emits a hard-pinned
`COPILOT_MODEL: claude-sonnet-5` in the detection job — no repo/org variable
can override it back to `auto`.

Locks regenerated from source via the update-workflow-versions skill: gh-aw
v0.84.3 (release build) with DefaultThreatDetectVersion patched to detector
v0.3.4. No manual lock edits.

Co-authored-by: Copilot <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>

Co-authored-by: David Slater <12449447+davidslater@users.noreply.github.com>

* chore(workflows): bump remaining smoke and monitor locks to gh-aw v0.84.3

Recompile the claude/codex standalone smokes and the standard monitor
workflows so every lock tracks the versions the gh-aw Version Check expects:

- compiler_version -> v0.84.3 (stable == latest gh-aw) for all workflows
- detector -> v0.3.4 (latest) for every *-standalone-latest lock

No frontmatter/model changes; this is a pure version bump (AWF 0.27.42->0.27.43,
Copilot CLI 1.0.75->1.0.77, gh-aw-mcpg v0.4.6->v0.4.7, github-mcp-server
v1.7.0->v1.8.0, setup action v0.83.4/v0.84.0->v0.84.3). Locks regenerated via
the update-workflow-versions skill (release build of gh-aw v0.84.3 with
DefaultThreatDetectVersion patched to v0.3.4); no manual lock edits.

Co-authored-by: Copilot <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>

Co-authored-by: David Slater <12449447+davidslater@users.noreply.github.com>
